item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
So yeah. This is my first story. Well, my second story, actually, but I didn't publish it, so let's not talk about that one. *shudder*

You know how it is; suddenly you get this great idea, and it's a mad dash to the keyboard to jot it all down. Then you sit on it for months and months untill you go back and make it look presentable.

Note that I did send this around on the forums for comments… several months ago. I don't think anyone said anything more descriptive than "Keep it up, d00d.".

So how is it? Any feedback is appreciated.
